name: Lemlist
description: Cold outreach email software with automated email warm-up and high deliverability for supplier and B2B outreach.
fullDescription: Lemlist is specialized sales outreach software engineered for high email deliverability. With its built-in lemwarm engine, cold email warmup prevents domain blacklisting, while personalized image generation and multi-channel outreach make it ideal for contacting overseas manufacturers, wholesale distributors, and retail partners.
features: Automated lemwarm email deliverability and domain warmup system
Dynamic personalized images and custom video landing pages per lead
Multi-channel outreach sequences combining Email, LinkedIn, and phone tasks
Custom tracking domain setup with DMARC, DKIM, and SPF validation
B2B lead database with 450M+ verified professional email addresses
